purpose: Run the already implemented and reviewed six-control Decimal enclosure once on the changed NCP host, then compare actual fresh scientific fields with the saved N512/P60 result.

authority.execution_commit_source: Read immutable scientific_core_commit from the final detached E13C4 delivery receipt supplied with this package; never substitute intake_commit_context_only or a moving branch HEAD.
authority.source_policy: EXECUTION_LOCK.json is the exact source/input/PLAN/N512 scientific identity contract; FILE_MANIFEST.json covers archive payload identity.
authority.existing_authorization: Scoped continuation, non-destructive staging/worktrees, one changed-host replay, same-branch additive non-force publication and designated create-only backups when needed; no merge, production action, or messages to other people.

required_reads: AGENTS.md from the pinned repository context and applicable ancestors of the target worktree
Only relevant portions of THEORY.md or evidence/theory/THEORY_CONTRIBUTION.md when needed to resolve a concrete execution question

input_and_worktree_rules.output_directory: A fresh nonexisting path supplied through --out; absolute preferred, relative accepted by runner; collisions and symlinks must not be overwritten.
input_and_worktree_rules.archive_requirement: Full archive retains all inherited research payload and provenance; compact Git includes all seven EXECUTION_LOCK runtime files.

runtime.incoming_correction: exact zero separately for each selected local initial-value problem
runtime.execution_mode: serial single scientific process; do not invoke through mpirun or srun multi-task
host_evidence: Python implementation/version and Decimal libmpdec version
CPU count/topology available to the process, affinity and quota
cgroup memory constraint and applied address-space cap
Allowlisted nonsensitive MPI/thread environment values only
Actual start/finish, wall duration, child exit or signal, peak RSS when reported

commands.package_argument: --package <absolute_package_root> is optional; omitted means the runner's default package root.
commands.default_semantics: Without --execute, only source/host verification occurs and scientific execution remains NOT_RUN. A separate preflight invocation is optional; --execute performs required checks itself.

parity.baseline: Saved N512/P60 scientific projection pinned by EXECUTION_LOCK.json
parity.comparison: Exact equality of the runner-defined scientific projection; exclude only documented environment, command location and timing metadata, never numerical enclosures, domains, control IDs, precision, subdivisions, rounding counts or compatibility findings.

forbidden: E13C2 continuous reference or saved oracle recomputation
Old native/full3x384/gas/Newton solver replay or a new gas history
Unchanged full test suite or review replay
First2/full-path extension, nonzero outflow, new source/threshold/anchor/gas model
Fortran or ordinary binary64 replacement of this validated Decimal lane
Changing precision, N, arithmetic, numerical projection or scientific acceptance to obtain parity
Automatic rerun after the scoped scientific process has started and failed or timed out
Treating same-host repeated work without a changed input or method as a new necessary validation
Rewriting source locks, prior result files, history or user changes
Merge, production admission, or messages to other people

failure_and_repairs.allowed_without_scientific_change: Select an existing compatible CPython interpreter, resolve package paths and choose a fresh output directory; retain evidence of any failed preflight.
failure_and_repairs.source_byte_change_requires_return: Do not rewrite EXECUTION_LOCK to bless a local patch. If code bytes must change, preserve a minimal diff and the first failure and return to the research owner for a newly bound payload.
failure_and_repairs.numerical_domain_parity_or_math_failure: Return unresolved with actual differing fields and logs; do not alter algorithms, tolerances or certificate meaning.
failure_and_repairs.unsupported_runtime_or_missing_input: BLOCKED or NOT_RUN with concrete reason; do not silently substitute another arithmetic backend.
failure_and_repairs.scientific_process_timeout: TIMEOUT, not PASS; retain partial START/checkpoint/stdout/stderr and actual termination information.

runner_outputs.failure_rule: Preserve every file actually produced and the missing-file state. A failure before a phase may legitimately omit that phase's output; never fabricate a completed result or parity file.
runner_outputs.parity_flag: PARITY.bitwise_numerical_json_parity refers to equality of the canonical scientific JSON projection, not whole raw output files including environment and timing.

machine_summary_required_fields: task, immutable scientific core commit, source/input/PLAN/baseline hashes
execution status distinct from parity verdict and scientific/production claim ceiling
actual interpreter, host/affinity/quota/memory and allowed environment
actual argv, started/finished times, process exit or signal, elapsed and measured RSS
precision 60, N512, six exact IDs, actual scientific run count
fresh numerical projection identity, baseline identity, exact parity result and first mismatching paths
first failure, any allowed path/interpreter correction, unexecuted items and next required action
publication/backups receipt only if performed, with actual ACK/object/size/path evidence
required_return.publication: If needed under existing authorization, add a new run/evidence path to the same branch using a fresh remote HEAD and non-force expected-head protection; never overwrite the sealed E13C4 baseline.
required_return.backups: Use the designated Drive/Dropbox destinations and create-only unique result names from the final delivery receipt/context; metadata/size ACK is R1, not a remote restore test.

next_science.scope: Research owner must first derive and implement incoming uncertainty and anchor representation propagation in the ChatGPT research thread; do not silently add full-path implementation to this host-parity job.
